name: ColorSwatch
summary: A round sample of a colour, with a thin inner ring so a colour the same as the background still shows.

a11y.keyboardNote: role=img named by label (or the colour value). Not interactive.

props.name: color
props.description: REQUIRED. Any CSS colour: #f0c200, oklch(…), var(--primary).

props.name: size
props.description: 16, 24, 32, 36, 40 — the reference library's scale. Round only, and without the transparency checkerboard (Victor's decision).

props.name: label
props.description: The name a screen reader announces ("Aurea yellow"). Without it, the colour value.
